definitionEn: n. the state of being unemployed or not having a job
definitionZh: n. 失业, 失业人数\n[经] 失业

example.translationZh: 上一季度失业率上升到了8%。

definitionEn: a. not even or uniform as e.g. in shape or texture\ns. variable and recurring at irregular intervals
definitionZh: a. 不平坦的, 不均等的, 奇数的

example.text: Be careful when you walk on uneven ground.
example.translationZh: 在不平坦的地面上行走时要小心。

definitionEn: a. not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception
definitionZh: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的\n[法] 不正直的, 不公平的, 偏颇的

example.text: It is unfair to blame her for the mistake.
example.translationZh: 因为这个错误而责怪她是不公平的。

definitionEn: v. open to the view\nv. extend or stretch out to a greater or the full length\nv. spread out or open from a closed or folded state
definitionZh: vt. 展开, 打开, 披露, 开展, 挑明\nvi. 伸展, 开花, 呈现

example.text: She unfolded the map on the table to find the shortest route.
example.translationZh: 她把地图在桌上展开，以找出最短的路线。

definitionEn: s lacking grace in movement or posture\ns difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
definitionZh: a. 难看的, 不优雅的, 粗陋的

example.text: The young colt had an ungainly walk, tripping over its own long legs.
example.translationZh: 这匹小马驹步态笨拙，常被自己的长腿绊倒。

definitionEn: a. not in or exhibiting good health in body or mind\ns. not conducive to good health
definitionZh: a. 不健康的

example.text: Eating too much fast food and never exercising can lead to an unhealthy lifestyle.
example.translationZh: 吃太多快餐又从不锻炼会导致不健康的生活方式。

definitionEn: a. involving only one part or side\ns. tracing descent from either the paternal or the maternal line only
definitionZh: a. 单方面的, 单边的, 片面的\n[医] 单侧的, 一侧的

example.text: The manager made a unilateral decision to change the project deadline without consulting the team.
example.translationZh: 经理没有咨询团队就单方面决定更改项目截止日期。

definitionEn:
n. an organization of employees formed to bargain with the employer
n. the United States (especially the northern states during the American Civil War)
n. the state of being joined or united or linked
n. healing process involving the growing together of the edges of a wound or the growing together of broken bones
definitionZh: n. 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会\n[化] 联合; 联管节; 活接头

example.text: The workers formed a union to negotiate better wages and working conditions.
example.translationZh: 工人们成立了工会，以争取更好的工资和工作条件。

definitionEn: a. characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
definitionZh: a. 联合的, 团结的, 一致的, 和睦的\n[法] 联合的, 统一的, 一致的

example.text: The team remained united despite the challenges.
example.translationZh: 尽管面临挑战，团队仍然保持团结。

definitionEn:
n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages
n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something of all members of a class
n. a behavioral convention or pattern characteristic of all members of a particular culture or of all human beings
s. applicable to or common to all members of a group or set

example.text: Music is often called a universal language that everyone can understand.
example.translationZh: 音乐常被称为一种人人都能理解的通用语言。

definitionEn: n the body of faculty and students at a university\nn establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching\nn a large and diverse institution of higher learning created to educate for life and for a profession and to grant degrees
definitionZh: n. 大学( university的名词复数 )

example.text: Many students dream of studying at world-class universities.
example.translationZh: 许多学生梦想在世界一流大学学习。

definitionEn: a. has little chance of being the case or coming about
definitionZh: a. 不太可能的

example.text: It is unlikely that the match will be cancelled because of the rain.
example.translationZh: 比赛不太可能因为下雨而取消。

definitionEn: v. become or cause to become undone by separating the fibers or threads of
definitionZh: vt. 阐明, 解决, 解开\nvi. 散开

example.text: Detectives worked for years to unravel the mystery of the missing painting.
example.translationZh: 侦探们花了数年时间揭开那幅失踪画作的谜团。

definitionEn: a. not worthy of reliance or trust\ns. lacking a sense of responsibility
definitionZh: a. 不可靠的\n[法] 不可靠的, 靠不住的

example.text: The witness turned out to be an unreliable source of information.
example.translationZh: 结果证明那名证人是不可靠的信息来源。

definitionEn: n. a feeling of restless agitation
definitionZh: n. 不安的状态, 动荡的局面\n[医] 不安

example.text: The new tax law caused widespread social unrest.
example.translationZh: 新税法导致了广泛的社会动荡。

definitionEn: a. not seeking or given to association; being or living without companions
definitionZh: a. 非社会的, 厌恶社交的, 不喜交际的, 孤僻的

example.text: Nurses often work unsocial hours, including nights and weekends.
example.translationZh: 护士经常在非社交时段工作，包括夜间和周末。

phrase.translationZh: 非社交时段（指正常社交时间之外的工作时间）

definitionEn: s. of an incalculable amount
definitionZh: a. 未说过的, 未透露的, 未加叙述的, 数不清的, 无限的, 不可计量的, 无数的\n[法] 未说明的, 未方露的, 未说出的

example.text: The old sailor returned home with untold stories of distant lands.
example.translationZh: 那位老水手带着关于遥远国度的无数未曾讲述的故事回到了家。

definitionEn: a. not usual or common or ordinary\ns. not commonly encountered
definitionZh: a. 不寻常的, 罕见的, 与众不同的

example.text: It is unusual for him to arrive late, so something must have happened.
example.translationZh: 他迟到是不寻常的，所以一定发生了什么事。

definitionEn: s. reflecting the latest information or changes\ns. in accord with the most fashionable ideas or style
definitionZh: a. 直到现在的, 最近的, 现代化的\n[化] 最新的

example.text: Please make sure your contact information is up-to-date before the deadline.
example.translationZh: 请确保在截止日期前你的联系信息是最新的。

definitionEn:
n. news that updates your information
v. modernize or bring up to date
v. bring up to date; supply with recent information
v. bring to the latest state of technology
definitionZh: vt. 更新, 使现代化\nn. 更新\n[计] 更新

example.text: Please update the system before you install the new software.
example.translationZh: 安装新软件之前，请先更新系统。

definitionEn: v. stand up for; stick up for; of causes, principles, or ideals\nv. support against an opponent
definitionZh: vt. 支撑, 赞成, 鼓励, 举起, 坚持\n[法] 确认, 赞成, 支持

example.text: Judges must uphold the law and ensure fair trials.
example.translationZh: 法官必须维护法律并确保公平审判。

definitionEn: n activity involved in maintaining something in good working order\nn the act of sustaining life by food or providing a means of subsistence
definitionZh: n. 维持, 维修费\n[经] 维修费, 养护费, 保养

example.text: The landlord raised the rent to cover the upkeep of the building.
example.translationZh: 房东提高了房租，以支付这栋楼的维护费用。

definitionEn: n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake\nn. a piano with a vertical sounding board\ns. in a vertical position; not sloping
definitionZh: a. 正直的, 诚实的, 公正的, 垂直的, 竖式的\n[化] 立杆

example.text: The doctor told him to sit upright while she checked his back.
example.translationZh: 医生让他坐直，她要检查他的背部。

definitionEn:

v come into existence; take on form or shape

v return from the dead
v get up and out of bed
definitionZh: n. 起义, 升起\n[法] 起义, 暴动

example.text: The government sent troops to crush the armed uprising in the northern provinces.
example.translationZh: 政府派兵镇压了北方各省的武装起义。

definitionEn:
n. the act of disturbing the mind or body
n. a tool used to thicken or spread metal (the end of a bar or a rivet etc.) by forging or hammering or swaging
n. the act of upsetting something
v. disturb the balance or stability of
definitionZh: a. 弄翻的, 混乱的, 心烦的\nvt. 弄翻, 颠覆, 推翻, 打乱, 使不适, 使心烦\nvi. 翻倒

example.text: She tends to get upset when people criticize her work.
example.translationZh: 当人们批评她的工作时，她往往会感到心烦。

definitionEn: n. poor and often mischievous city child
definitionZh: n. 淘气鬼, 顽童

example.text: The kind baker always gave a warm loaf to the little street urchin.
example.translationZh: 那位善良的面包师总会给那个小街头顽童一个热乎乎的面包。

definitionEn: n. the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written
definitionZh: n. 用法, 使用, 习惯, 惯用法, 习惯法\n[经] 使用情况, 使用用途, 惯例

example.text: The word has fallen out of common usage in recent years.
example.translationZh: 这个词近年来已不再被普遍使用。

definitionEn: a. being of use or service
definitionZh: a. 有用的, 有益的\n[机] 有用的, 有效的

example.text: This dictionary is a useful tool for learning English.
example.translationZh: 这本词典是学习英语的有用工具。

definitionEn: a. having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
definitionZh: a. 无用的, 无效的, 无益的\n[机] 无用, 无价值, 无效

example.text: Without a battery, the flashlight is completely useless.
example.translationZh: 没有电池，这个手电筒完全没用。

definitionEn: a. occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
definitionZh: a. 平常的, 通常的

example.text: She arrived at the office at nine o'clock, as usual.
example.translationZh: 她像往常一样九点到达办公室。

definitionEn: n an implement for practical use (especially in a household)
definitionZh: n. 器具, 用具, 器皿( utensil的名词复数 ); 器物

example.text: She keeps all the kitchen utensils in the drawer next to the stove.
example.translationZh: 她把所有厨房用具都放在炉子旁边的抽屉里。

definitionEn:
n. a company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
n. the quality of being of practical use
n. the service (electric power or water or transportation) provided by a public utility
n. (economics) a measure that is to be maximized in any situation involving choice
definitionZh: n. 功用, 有用之物, 实用, 公用事业, 实用程序\na. 实用的, 有多种用途的\n[计] 实用程序, 工具

example.text: The city council regulates the rates charged by public utilities such as water and electricity providers.
example.translationZh: 市议会监管供水、供电等公用事业公司收取的费用。

definitionEn: n. the greatest possible degree
definitionZh: n. 极限, 最大限度, 极度\na. 极度的, 最远的

example.text: She did her utmost to finish the report before the deadline.
example.translationZh: 她竭尽全力在截止日期前完成了报告。

definitionZh: adv. 完全地, 全然, 绝对

example.translationZh: 马拉松结束后，她精疲力竭，几乎站都站不住。

definitionEn: n being unoccupied\nn an empty area or space
definitionZh: n. 空缺额；缺位（vacancy复数）

example.translationZh: 这家酒店在淡季有几个空房间。

definitionEn: n. being unoccupied
definitionZh: n. 空, 空白, 空缺, 空虚, 空闲\n[化] 空位

example.translationZh: 这家酒店本周末有几个空房。

definitionEn: n. leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure\nn. the act of making something legally void\nv. spend or take a vacation
definitionZh: n. 假期, 休假\n[法] 假期, 停审期, 休庭期

example.translationZh: 我们打算在暑假期间去海边。

definitionZh: n. 牛痘苗, 疫苗\na. 疫苗的, 牛痘的

example.text: The government plans a nationwide vaccine rollout starting next month.
example.translationZh: 政府计划下个月开始在全国范围内推广疫苗。

n. a region that is devoid of matter

v. clean with a vacuum cleaner
definitionZh: n. 真空, 空间, 真空吸尘器\na. 真空的, 产生真空的, 利用真空的\nvt. 用吸尘器打扫

example.translationZh: 她用真空吸尘器清除地毯上的灰尘。

definitionEn: s characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance\ns unproductive of success

example.translationZh: 她徒劳地试图打开那扇锁着的门。

example.translationZh: 律师们质疑合同的有效性，因为缺少了一个签名。

definitionEn: n. a long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river
definitionZh: n. 山谷, 溪谷, 流域, 凹地\n[医] 谷

example.translationZh: 这个小村庄位于一个绿色山谷的底部。

definitionEn: n. assessed price
definitionZh: n. 评价, 估价, 价值判断\n[经] 估价, 计价, 评价

example.translationZh: 银行在批准抵押贷款前要求对房产进行专业估价。

definitionZh: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果\nvt. 评价, 估价, 重视\n[计] 计算结果

example.text: Customers are increasingly looking for value for money when they shop.
example.translationZh: 顾客在购物时越来越追求物有所值。

definitionEn:

n. device in a brass wind instrument for varying the length of the air column to alter the pitch of a tone
n. control consisting of a mechanical device for controlling the flow of a fluid

definitionZh: n. 活瓣, 阀, 活门\nv. 装阀, 用阀调节

example.translationZh: 医生说他的心脏瓣膜功能正常。

example.translationZh: 魔术师让鸽子在我们眼前消失得无影无踪。

example.translationZh: 她买那辆昂贵的汽车是出于虚荣心，而不是需要。

definitionEn: v come out better in a competition, race, or conflict
definitionZh: vt. 打败, 征服, 克服\n[法] 征服, 战胜, 击败

example.translationZh: 将军率领部队在一场决战中击败了敌人。

definitionZh: n. 易变的事物, 变数, 可变物, 变量\na. 可变的, 不定的, 易变的, 变量的\n[计] 变量

example.translationZh: 这个实验产生了变化不定的结果，因此科学家们重复进行了几次。

definitionEn: s. differing from a norm or standard\ns. exhibiting variation and change
definitionZh: n. 变体, 异体\na. 不同的, 有差别的\n[计] 变体型

example.text: Scientists have identified a new variant of the virus that spreads more quickly.
example.translationZh: 科学家发现了一种传播速度更快的新病毒变体。

definitionEn:
n. an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change
n. an activity that varies from a norm or standard
n. a repetition of a musical theme in which it is modified or embellished
n. an artifact that deviates from a norm or standard
definitionZh: n. 变更, 变化, 变种, 变奏\n[医] 变异, 变易; 变度

example.translationZh: 沙漠中昼夜温差很大。

definitionZh: a. 不同的, 杂色的, 各式各样的\n[法] 不同的, 种种的, 变化的

example.translationZh: 营养学家建议食用富含水果和蔬菜的多样化饮食。

example.translationZh: 这个农贸市场出售各种各样的新鲜蔬菜。

definitionEn:
s of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
s considered individually
s distinctly dissimilar or unlike

example.translationZh: 在过去十年里，她曾在多个不同的国家生活过。

example.translationZh: 她在屋后的花园里自己种蔬菜。

definitionZh: n. 素食者, 食草动物\na. 素食的

example.translationZh: 她在市中心的素食餐馆点了一道豆腐菜。

definitionZh: n. 植物\n[医] 贽生物, 贽疣, 增殖体; 生长, 增殖

example.translationZh: 探险者们不得不穿过茂密的植被才能到达古代遗址。

definitionEn: s. characterized by great force or energy

example.translationZh: 她对这项提议的激烈反对让所有人都感到惊讶。

definitionZh: n. 面纱, 面罩, 借口, 幕, 帐, 遮蔽物\nvt. 戴面纱, 隐藏, 遮蔽, 掩饰\nvi. 蒙上面纱

example.translationZh: 委员会选择对报告中令人尴尬的细节避而不谈。

example.translationZh: 刷完墙后，她打开所有窗户给房间通风。

example.translationZh: 良好的言语沟通能力对这份工作至关重要。

example.translationZh: 经过三天的审议，陪审团终于作出了裁决。

example.translationZh: 她是一位多才多艺的女演员，既能演戏剧角色，也能演喜剧角色。

example.translationZh: 这场辩论将围绕言论自由与国家安全之间的对立展开。

definitionEn:
n. something that is oriented vertically

example.translationZh: 该公司通过收购其主要供应商和分销商实现了垂直整合。

example.translationZh: 医生说阻塞发生在他心脏附近的一条小血管里。

example.translationZh: 那位退伍军人与学生们分享了他的回忆。

example.translationZh: 兽医给这只狗做了检查，并给它接种了疫苗。

example.translationZh: 她因机场无休止的延误而感到烦恼。

example.translationZh: 那只狗凶猛地攻击了一个孩子，随后被实施了安乐死。

example.translationZh: 她在做晚饭前看了一段关于做意大利面的短视频。

definitionEn:
n the visible part of a television transmission
n a recording of both the visual and audible components (especially one containing a recording of a movie or television program)
n (computer science) the appearance of text and graphics on a video display
n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects

example.translationZh: 她花了一下午观看她最喜欢的乐队演唱会的视频。

example.translationZh: 侦探查看了监控摄像头的录像带以确认嫌疑人。

example.translationZh: 鉴于天气恶劣，我们决定推迟野餐。

example.translationZh: 安保团队整夜保持警惕，密切注意任何可疑活动。

example.translationZh: 她搬到了乡下，因为她更喜欢乡村生活，而不是城市的喧嚣。

example.translationZh: 新的证据彻底证明他面对的所有指控均不成立。
